# Every field type

`all_types` has a field of each type, with defaults, a validation and a sensitive field.

<Inputs id="all_types">
```yaml
variables:
  - name: plain_string
    type: string
    description: A plain string with a default
    default: hello world
  - name: required_string
    type: string
    description: This field is required
    validations:
      - required
  - name: email_field
    type: string
    description: Must be a valid email address
    default: user@example.com
    validations:
      - email
  - name: int_field
    type: int
    description: An integer input
    default: 42
  - name: float_field
    type: float
    description: A decimal input
    default: 0.5
  - name: bool_field
    type: bool
    description: A boolean toggle
    default: true
  - name: enum_field
    type: enum
    description: Pick an environment
    options: [dev, staging, prod]
    default: dev
  - name: list_field
    type: list
    description: A dynamic list of items
  - name: choices_field
    type: list
    description: Pick any regions
    x-options: [us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-south-1]
    default: [us-east-1]
  - name: map_field
    type: map
    description: A key-value map
  - name: secret_field
    type: string
    description: A sensitive password field
    sensitive: true
    default: s3cret
```
</Inputs>

`show` reads every field. It gives the secret's length, not the secret.

<Command
  id="show"
  inputsId="all_types"
  env={{
    PLAIN: "{{ .inputs.plain_string }}",
    REQUIRED: "{{ .inputs.required_string }}",
    EMAIL: "{{ .inputs.email_field }}",
    INT: "{{ .inputs.int_field }}",
    FLOAT: "{{ .inputs.float_field }}",
    BOOL: "{{ .inputs.bool_field }}",
    ENUM: "{{ .inputs.enum_field }}",
    LIST: "{{ .inputs.list_field }}",
    CHOICES: "{{ .inputs.choices_field }}",
    MAP: "{{ .inputs.map_field }}",
    SECRET: "{{ .inputs.secret_field }}",
  }}
  outputs={["plain", "required", "email", "int", "float", "bool", "enum", "list", "choices", "map", "secret_length"]}
  command={`{
  echo "plain=$PLAIN"
  echo "required=$REQUIRED"
  echo "email=$EMAIL"
  echo "int=$INT"
  echo "float=$FLOAT"
  echo "bool=$BOOL"
  echo "enum=$ENUM"
  echo "list=$LIST"
  echo "choices=$CHOICES"
  echo "map=$MAP"
  echo "secret_length=\${#SECRET}"
} >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"`}
/>
